TRANSPARENCY · PRIVACY · RESPONSIBLE PARTNERSHIPS

Your information.
Handled with care.

How POIGAI uses its climate knowledge bank, consent-based stakeholder accounts, project records, donor enquiries and organisation-directory data.

Disclosure edition 16 October 2026. This page describes the current implementation and intended safeguards; it is not a certificate of legal compliance. Formal legal review and a published retention schedule remain pending.

Privacy and information practices

Visitors can read the public climate knowledge bank without registering. The source-linked district planning screens and downloadable climate CSVs contain no verified personal-beneficiary data. The records are research and POIGAI screening synthesis, not independently established site conditions.

Public website visitor measurement uses a monthly network-based estimate. A keyed hash of the network address and calendar month prevents repeated counting within that month. POIGAI does not store raw IP addresses, visitor cookies, user agents or browsing histories for this counter. Shared networks may count as one visitor and known automated clients are excluded; the figure is an estimate, not an exact count of people. The previous month’s identifiers are removed during routine database cleanup. Measurement starts at activation and cannot reconstruct earlier visits.

When you register, enquire or propose a project, POIGAI may collect the details you submit: name, email, stakeholder category, organisation, region, consent, project description, estimated budget, evidence notes and performance observations. Essential authentication/session cookies and rate-limiting information are used to protect accounts and services.

Account passwords are processed for authentication and not published. POIGAI's application uses Cloudflare hosting/database services and configured email-delivery providers for verification or recovery emails. Never submit identity documents, financial account details, passwords or identifiable beneficiary lists through free-text fields.

Organisation profiles are private by default. A profile enters the public directory only after affirmative publication consent and POIGAI administrator verification. Only a limited organisation name, type, location, description and optional website are published; account owner email, private registration details and submitted documents are not included.

Project drafts remain available only to their authenticated owners and the restricted administrator review system. Matching summaries become visible to qualified funders only if both sides opt in and the project passes an eligibility review. Matching does not grant funding approval or sharing of beneficiary identities.

POIGAI has not yet implemented a finalised data-retention/deletion automation or a self-service data portability workflow. You can request access, correction, consent withdrawal or deletion assessment using the contact address below. Legal retention duties and legitimate records of payments or contracts, if subsequently created, would need specific handling.

Website and data-use terms

Climate problem screens are initial planning information, not current emergency warnings, engineering designs, certifications, funding guarantees, or legal/financial advice. Verify the appropriate government hazard data, local conditions and statutory requirements before acting.

Third-party sources, including NGO Darpan and linked government portals, remain under their own licences and use conditions. POIGAI is not affiliated with or endorsed by NITI Aayog, NGO Darpan or a government authority by virtue of citing them. Downloaded POIGAI screening datasets retain source limitations and must not be relabelled as independently verified needs or approved projects.

Public donation collection is not enabled. CSR-1 implementing-agency eligibility, FCRA registration or prior permission, organisational legal status and tax treatment must be evaluated for each relevant transaction or organisation. Registration, proposal submission, a directory listing or a preliminary match is not a funding commitment.

Organisation users are responsible for submitting accurate, authorised information; must obtain lawful permissions and appropriate consent before sharing third-party data; and must not submit confidential beneficiary details in public-form fields. POIGAI may withhold publication, request corrections and restrict misleading or unsafe submissions.

Corrections, concerns and complaints

To request a correction to an organisation listing, withdraw publication consent, report inaccurate climate-source information, request account assistance or raise a privacy concern, email contact@poigai.com. Include a reference ID where available, but never email your password or activation token.

POIGAI should publish a designated statutory grievance-officer identity and legally compliant retention/deletion procedures after entity-specific counsel review and appointment. Until then, this is the listed operational contact—not a claim that every required legal appointment has been completed.
